configuration_sources_and_source_digests.stdout:
# Workbench PostgreSQL host-based authentication (OPS-001, R3).
#
# TLS only. Every TCP rule is `hostssl` and requires a client certificate
# whose Common Name equals the login role (clientcert=verify-full) *and* a
# SCRAM-SHA-256 password. There is no `host` and no `hostnossl` rule, so a
# plaintext TCP connection has no rule to match and is refused before
# authentication.
#
# The one `local` rule is the Unix-domain socket inside the container, used by
# the image's own initialization and by scripts/init-database.sh through
# `docker compose exec` as the postgres OS user. It is not a TCP listener.
#
# TYPE     DATABASE  USER      ADDRESS       METHOD         OPTIONS
local      all       postgres                peer
hostssl    all       all       0.0.0.0/0     scram-sha-256  clientcert=verify-full
hostssl    all       all       ::/0          scram-sha-256  clientcert=verify-full
# Workbench PostgreSQL server configuration (OPS-001). Mounted read-only and
# selected explicitly with `-c config_file=`; the data directory's generated
# postgresql.conf is not read. Every value here is non-secret.

# Connections
listen_addresses = '*'
port = 5432
max_connections = 50
unix_socket_directories = '/var/run/postgresql'

# TLS only. The material lives in the read-only PKI volume; the server
# certificate's SANs are exactly postgres, localhost and 127.0.0.1.
ssl = on
ssl_ca_file = '/var/lib/postgresql/pki/ca.crt'
ssl_cert_file = '/var/lib/postgresql/pki/server.crt'
ssl_key_file = '/var/lib/postgresql/pki/server.key'
ssl_min_protocol_version = 'TLSv1.3'
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers = on

# Authentication
password_encryption = scram-sha-256
hba_file = '/etc/postgresql/pg_hba.conf'

# Memory (single-operator local profile)
shared_buffers = 128MB
dynamic_shared_memory_type = posix

# Time: the workbench stores timestamptz at microsecond precision and reads it
# back as UTC; the server clock is UTC so logs and data agree.
timezone = 'UTC'
log_timezone = 'UTC'
datestyle = 'iso, ymd'

# Logging: metadata only, to stderr (docker logs). No statement logging.
log_destination = 'stderr'
logging_collector = off
log_min_messages = warning
log_connections = on
log_disconnections = on
log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %u@%d %r '

default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.english'

import hashlib, json, pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path('docs/evidence/heb-154/agent-code-v2')
path = root / 'physical-runtime-binding.md'
parent = root / 'execution-contract.md'
doc, authority = path.read_text(), parent.read_text()
expected = {'PB-runtime', 'PB-transport', 'PB-persistence'}
known = set(re.findall(r'\bFRDX-[a-z-]+\b', authority))
def validate(text):
    rows = re.findall(r'^\| (PB-[a-z-]+) \|', text, re.M)
    if set(rows) != expected or len(rows) != len(expected):
        raise ValueError('decision_membership')
    if not re.search(r'^\| Status \| PROPOSED;', text, re.M):
        raise ValueError('proposal_status')
    refs = set(re.findall(r'\bFRDX-[a-z-]+\b', text))
    if not refs <= known:
        raise ValueError('unknown_obligation')
    return sorted(refs)
refs = validate(doc)
controls = []
for name, changed, reason in [
    ('missing_decision', re.sub(r'^\| PB-runtime \|[^\n]+\n', '', doc, count=1, flags=re.M), 'decision_membership'),
    ('unknown_obligation', doc + '\nFRDX-undeclared\n', 'unknown_obligation'),
    ('false_status', doc.replace('| Status | PROPOSED;', '| Status | IMPLEMENTED;', 1), 'proposal_status')
]:
    try:
        validate(changed)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == reason
        controls.append(name)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('dirty_control_not_detected:' + name)
